subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw require exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss stream proof before accepting any recovery path that reclassifies assistant text as executable tool calls?
rationale: The safe implementation depends on whether maintainers want a narrow fix from a proven stream fixture or are willing to sponsor provider-specific recovery before the exact stream is captured; that choice affects the tool-execution boundary.

options.title: Require exact stream proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only the proven parser path.

options.title: Sponsor vLLM-specific recovery
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned provider-specific recovery design if exact reproduction is impractical, with security review and tests for false text-to-tool promotion.

options.title: Treat docs workaround as enough
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the documented vLLM tool_choice and server-parser guidance covers this deployment class despite the reporter's structured-wire evidence.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only the proven parser path.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent merged history in the reasoning/tool-call parser path that would need the proof threshold and fix-shape decision.
